sloka: पद्मकाः च एव शोभन्ते नील अशोकाः ।च पुष्पिताःलोध्राः च गिरि पृष्ठेषु सिंह केसर पिन्जराः  ॥४-१-७९॥
transliteration: padmakāḥ ca eva śobhante nīla aśokāḥ ।ca puṣpitāḥlodhrāḥ ca giri pṛṣṭheṣu siṁha kesara pinjarāḥ  ॥4-1-79॥

translations.english: 'There are trees like ankola, kuranta, churnaka, paribhadraka, mango, patali, kovidara, muchukunda, arjuna, ketaka, uddalaka, shirisha, shimshupa and shava, all in full bloom on the mountain peaks.
